sources.summary: OpenAI has released new prompt templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol meant to fix common model behaviors such as overly brief answers, unnecessary follow-up questions, and excessive testing when coding. The API is changing as well, since editing a conversation's history can discard reasoning content and lower response quality. The article OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title_en: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.title_original: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 數學家勒文特·阿爾波格（Levent Alpöge）表示，他利用 Claude 證明瞭黎曼猜想（數學界最著名且懸決 167 年的未解問題），該證明已在 Lean 中形式化，篇幅超過 25,000 頁。僅僅數小時後，史丹佛大學的研究人員發表了一份獨立且完全由人類完成的競爭證明，數學家們目前正在檢驗這兩者是否站得住腳。

stories.title: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條 / Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end

sources.title: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條 / Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條
sources.title_en: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_original: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

sources.title: 矽谷對 AI 末日的日益沉迷，正使部分科技產業走向類似邪教的狂熱 / Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
sources.title_zh: 矽谷對 AI 末日的日益沉迷，正使部分科技產業走向類似邪教的狂熱
sources.title_en: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
sources.title_original: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
sources.summary: A Buddhist monastery in Vermont called Maple wants to establish itself as Silicon Valley's spiritual authority while creating its own AI god. According to a New Yorker report, leader Soryu Forall's group records every breath its members take to train an AI in his image. Former members report manipulation and psychological breakdowns. The article Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 位於佛蒙特州名為 Maple 的佛教寺院希望建立自己作為矽谷精神權威的地位，同時創造自己的 AI 神明。根據《紐約客》報導，領袖 Soryu Forall 的團體記錄了成員們每一次的呼吸，以訓練出以他形象為本的 AI。前成員則回報了遭到操縱與心理崩潰的情況。

stories.title: 新型開源模型 Inkling 2 Mini 透過循環思考來以更少的字數解決問題，並且仍能在筆記型電腦上運行 / New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop

sources.title: 新型開源模型 Inkling 2 Mini 透過循環思考來以更少的字數解決問題，並且仍能在筆記型電腦上運行 / New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.title_zh: 新型開源模型 Inkling 2 Mini 透過循環思考來以更少的字數解決問題，並且仍能在筆記型電腦上運行
sources.title_en: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.title_original: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 發布了 Inkling 2 Mini，這是一個開迴圈 Transformer，每個 token 會運行其 24 層中的 12 層三次。這讓模型能夠在內部進行更長時間的推理，而無需生成額外的文字。在 Artificial Analysis 的智慧指數（Intelligence Index）上，它與 Qwen3.8 27B 並列，且成本大約低了六倍。

sources.summary: The Nasdaq 100 has slipped into a bear market after its worst weekly loss since the Covid-19 crisis. Nvidia plunged 14 percent as the SEC reviews its accounting, and Anthropic lost nearly all of its gains a day after its record IPO. AI doubts, scandals, rising interest rates, and political headwinds are hitting overheated valuations all at once. The article US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 那斯達克 100 指數在經歷自新冠疫情危機以來最糟糕的單週跌幅後，已陷入熊市。隨著美國證券交易委員會（SEC）審查其會計業務，輝達（Nvidia）暴跌 14%，而 Anthropic 在其創紀錄的 IPO 後隔天幾乎吐回了所有漲幅。對人工智慧的疑慮、醜聞、不斷上升的利率以及政治逆風，正同時打擊過熱的估值。

sources.title_original: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
sources.summary: Bytedance and several US universities introduce Axion 1.0, an AI agent that rivals top commercial models from OpenAI and Anthropic on benchmarks after just three training phases. The researchers attribute the gains to carefully curated training data rather than ever more training steps. The model, data, and code are freely available. The article Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 位元組跳動（Bytedance）與數所美國大學共同推出 Axion 1.0，這是一個 AI 代理，僅經過三個訓練階段，其基準測試表現就能媲美來自 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的頂級商業模型。研究人員將這些效能提升歸功於精心策劃的訓練資料，而非不斷增加的訓練步數。該模型、資料與程式碼皆可免費取得。

stories.title: OpenAI 使攻擊者更難提取其最新 AI 模型的思考方式 / OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think

sources.title: OpenAI 使攻擊者更難提取其最新 AI 模型的思考方式 / OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 使攻擊者更難提取其最新 AI 模型的思考方式
sources.title_en: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.title_original: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns. The article OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 大幅加強了防護措施，防止從 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 中提取內部推理。在自適應紅隊測試中，提取受保護推理的成功率從 54% 下降至 0.2%。該公司還因協同蒸餾活動每週停權數千到數萬個帳戶。

stories.title: Signal 在 iOS 27 與 Android 上封鎖截圖，以阻止 AI 代理讀取私人聊天內容 / Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats

sources.title: Signal 在 iOS 27 與 Android 上封鎖截圖，以阻止 AI 代理讀取私人聊天內容 / Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
sources.title_zh: Signal 在 iOS 27 與 Android 上封鎖截圖，以阻止 AI 代理讀取私人聊天內容
sources.title_en: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
sources.title_original: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
sources.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots to stop AI agents like Apple's Siri AI, Google's Gemini Intelligence, and Meta's Muse from reading private chats. The app calls it an "existential threat" to privacy, but admits its protections remain incomplete, including on macOS. Apple, Google, and Microsoft should follow suit. The article Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Signal 正在封鎖截圖功能，以阻止 蘋果的 Siri AI、Google's Gemini Intelligence 和 Meta's Muse 等 AI 代理讀取私人聊天內容。該應用程式稱這對隱私構成了「生存威脅」，但也坦承其保護措施仍不夠完善，包括在 macOS 上也是如此。蘋果、Google 和 微軟 應該效仿此做法。

stories.title: 同一天兩份廣義黎曼猜想證明：Claude 協作的 Lean 版，與一份 940 頁的「全人工」草稿

sources.title: 同一天兩份廣義黎曼猜想證明：Claude 協作的 Lean 版，與一份 940 頁的「全人工」草稿

sources.title_original: 同一天兩份廣義黎曼猜想證明：Claude 協作的 Lean 版，與一份 940 頁的「全人工」草稿
sources.summary: 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 數學家 Levent Alpöge 宣佈與 Claude 證明黎曼猜想與 GRH，只公佈 1,740 萬行的 Lean 程式碼；幾小時後 AMS 主席 Ravi Vakil 倉促貼出 Alessandro Masullo 一份 940 頁、強調沒有 AI 的 GRH 證明草稿。本文整理兩份證明的時間軸、方法差異、驗證進度，以及對密碼學與形式驗證的實際意義。

sources.title_en: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
sources.title_original: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
sources.summary: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”
sources.summary_zh: 在傳出多次外遇指控（包括與直屬部下以及據稱是中國情報資產的人交往）之際，知情人士向 WIRED 表示，Nvidia 董事會的主要問題在於前執行長「缺乏坦率」的態度。

sources.title_original: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
sources.summary: A Buddhist monastery in Vermont called Maple wants to establish itself as Silicon Valley's spiritual authority while creating its own AI god. According to a New Yorker report, leader Soryu Forall's group records every breath its members take to train an AI in his image. Former members report manipulation and psychological breakdowns. The article Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 位於佛蒙特州名為 Maple 的佛教寺院希望建立自己作為矽谷精神權威的地位，同時創造自己的 AI 神明。根據《紐約客》報導，領袖 Soryu Forall 的團體記錄了成員們每一次的呼吸，以訓練出以他形象為本的 AI。前成員則回報了遭到操縱與心理崩潰的情況。

items.title_original: Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion
items.summary: A Buddhist monastery in Vermont called Maple wants to establish itself as Silicon Valley's spiritual authority while creating its own AI god. According to a New Yorker report, leader Soryu Forall's group records every breath its members take to train an AI in his image. Former members report manipulation and psychological breakdowns. The article Silicon Valley's growing obsession with AI doomsday is turning parts of the tech industry toward cult-like devotion appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 位於佛蒙特州名為 Maple 的佛教寺院希望建立自己作為矽谷精神權威的地位，同時創造自己的 AI 神明。根據《紐約客》報導，領袖 Soryu Forall 的團體記錄了成員們每一次的呼吸，以訓練出以他形象為本的 AI。前成員則回報了遭到操縱與心理崩潰的情況。

sources.title: 在 Anthropic 宣稱以 Claude 證明黎曼猜想的數小時後，史丹佛大學發布了一份全由人類完成的競爭草案 / Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.title_zh: 在 Anthropic 宣稱以 Claude 證明黎曼猜想的數小時後，史丹佛大學發布了一份全由人類完成的競爭草案
sources.title_en: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.title_original: Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
sources.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 數學家勒文特·阿爾波格（Levent Alpöge）表示，他利用 Claude 證明瞭黎曼猜想（數學界最著名且懸決 167 年的未解問題），該證明已在 Lean 中形式化，篇幅超過 25,000 頁。僅僅數小時後，史丹佛大學的研究人員發表了一份獨立且完全由人類完成的競爭證明，數學家們目前正在檢驗這兩者是否站得住腳。

sources.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-Live-1.1 in the API. The full-duplex voice model improves multilingual accents and transcription, and a new standby mode bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05. The post OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 API 中推出 GPT-Live-1.1。這款全雙工語音模型改善了多語言口音與轉錄功能，且新的待機模式將閒置的 WebRTC 時間計費從每分鐘 $0.05 美元調降至 $0.02 美元。

events.news_summary: OpenAI強化GPT-6.2 Astra與Sol防護，推理提取成功率從54%降至0.2%。

sources.title: OpenAI 使攻擊者更難提取其最新 AI 模型的思考方式 / OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 使攻擊者更難提取其最新 AI 模型的思考方式
sources.title_en: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.title_original: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
sources.summary: OpenAI has significantly strengthened safeguards against extracting internal reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. In adaptive red-teaming tests, the success rate for extracting protected reasoning fell from 54 percent to 0.2 percent. The company is also suspending thousands to tens of thousands of accounts each week over coordinated distillation campaigns. The article OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 大幅加強了防護措施，防止從 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 中提取內部推理。在自適應紅隊測試中，提取受保護推理的成功率從 54% 下降至 0.2%。該公司還因協同蒸餾活動每週停權數千到數萬個帳戶。

sources.title_zh: Baseten 發布 Bison-1 與 Groundhog-1，榮登決策模型指數榜首
sources.title_en: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
sources.title_original: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
sources.summary: Baseten released bison-1 and groundhog-1, open-weight decision models built on Gemma 4. bison-1 scores 76 on the AA Decision Index v2.1, and both models support 128k context and image input. The post Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Baseten 發布了 bison-1 與 groundhog-1，這是建構於 Gemma 4 之上的開放權重決策模型。bison-1 在 AA 決策指數 v2.1（AA Decision Index v2.1）上獲得 76 分，且這兩個模型皆支援 128k 上下文與圖像輸入。

sources.title: 同一天兩份廣義黎曼猜想證明：Claude 協作的 Lean 版，與一份 940 頁的「全人工」草稿
sources.title_zh: 同一天兩份廣義黎曼猜想證明：Claude 協作的 Lean 版，與一份 940 頁的「全人工」草稿
sources.title_original: 同一天兩份廣義黎曼猜想證明：Claude 協作的 Lean 版，與一份 940 頁的「全人工」草稿
sources.summary: 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 數學家 Levent Alpöge 宣佈與 Claude 證明黎曼猜想與 GRH，只公佈 1,740 萬行的 Lean 程式碼；幾小時後 AMS 主席 Ravi Vakil 倉促貼出 Alessandro Masullo 一份 940 頁、強調沒有 AI 的 GRH 證明草稿。本文整理兩份證明的時間軸、方法差異、驗證進度，以及對密碼學與形式驗證的實際意義。

items.summary: 11 月 20 日，Anthropic 數學家 Levent Alpöge 宣佈與 Claude 證明黎曼猜想與 GRH，只公佈 1,740 萬行的 Lean 程式碼；幾小時後 AMS 主席 Ravi Vakil 倉促貼出 Alessandro Masullo 一份 940 頁、強調沒有 AI 的 GRH 證明草稿。本文整理兩份證明的時間軸、方法差異、驗證進度，以及對密碼學與形式驗證的實際意義。

sources.title_en: US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up
sources.title_original: US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up
sources.summary: The Nasdaq 100 has slipped into a bear market after its worst weekly loss since the Covid-19 crisis. Nvidia plunged 14 percent as the SEC reviews its accounting, and Anthropic lost nearly all of its gains a day after its record IPO. AI doubts, scandals, rising interest rates, and political headwinds are hitting overheated valuations all at once. The article US technology stocks suffer their worst weekly loss since the pandemic as AI doubts pile up appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 那斯達克 100 指數在經歷自新冠疫情危機以來最糟糕的單週跌幅後，已陷入熊市。隨著美國證券交易委員會（SEC）審查其會計業務，輝達（Nvidia）暴跌 14%，而 Anthropic 在其創紀錄的 IPO 後隔天幾乎吐回了所有漲幅。對人工智慧的疑慮、醜聞、不斷上升的利率以及政治逆風，正同時打擊過熱的估值。

events.news_summary: Nvidia研究員稱大型AI上下文窗口是死衚衕，測試顯示定期摘要與關鍵字搜尋能以極低成本達到相近效果。

sources.title: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條 / Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 研究人員主張龐大的 AI 上下文視窗是死路一條
sources.title_en: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.title_original: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end
sources.summary: Nvidia researchers argue that language models often don't need their full context windows—which are slow, expensive, and prone to errors—and propose an alternative. In tests, periodic summaries and targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost. The team even proposes a new class of models that works with short notes instead of long context. The article Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Nvidia 的研究人員主張，語言模型通常不需要其完整的上下文視窗（既緩慢、昂貴又容易出錯），並提出了一種替代方案。在測試中，定期摘要與針對性的關鍵字搜尋通常能以極低的成本達到與完整上下文相同的結果。該團隊甚至提出了一種新型態的模型，能以短筆記而非長上下文來運作。

sources.title: OpenAI 分享針對 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 的新提示詞技巧，以修正回答簡短與不必要的問題 / OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 分享針對 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 的新提示詞技巧，以修正回答簡短與不必要的問題
sources.title_en: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
sources.title_original: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
sources.summary: OpenAI has released new prompt templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol meant to fix common model behaviors such as overly brief answers, unnecessary follow-up questions, and excessive testing when coding. The API is changing as well, since editing a conversation's history can discard reasoning content and lower response quality. The article OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 針對 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 發布了新的提示詞範本，旨在修正常見的模型行為，例如回答過於簡短、不必要的後續問題，以及寫程式時過度的測試。API 也正在改變，因為編輯對話歷史記錄可能會丟棄推理內容並降低迴應品質。

sources.title: 位元組跳動主張大多數的 AI 訓練階段都是不必要的，並以一個具競爭力的開放模型來支持此論點 / Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
sources.title_zh: 位元組跳動主張大多數的 AI 訓練階段都是不必要的，並以一個具競爭力的開放模型來支持此論點
sources.title_en: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
sources.title_original: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model
sources.summary: Bytedance and several US universities introduce Axion 1.0, an AI agent that rivals top commercial models from OpenAI and Anthropic on benchmarks after just three training phases. The researchers attribute the gains to carefully curated training data rather than ever more training steps. The model, data, and code are freely available. The article Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 位元組跳動（Bytedance）與數所美國大學共同推出 Axion 1.0，這是一個 AI 代理，僅經過三個訓練階段，其基準測試表現就能媲美來自 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的頂級商業模型。研究人員將這些效能提升歸功於精心策劃的訓練資料，而非不斷增加的訓練步數。該模型、資料與程式碼皆可免費取得。

events.news_summary: Thinking Machines 發布開源模型 Inkling 2 Mini，在 Artificial Analysis 指數上與 Qwen3.8 27B 持平，成本約低六倍。

sources.title: 新型開源模型 Inkling 2 Mini 透過循環思考來以更少的字數解決問題，並且仍能在筆記型電腦上運行 / New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.title_zh: 新型開源模型 Inkling 2 Mini 透過循環思考來以更少的字數解決問題，並且仍能在筆記型電腦上運行
sources.title_en: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.title_original: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop
sources.summary: Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Thinking Machines 發布了 Inkling 2 Mini，這是一個開迴圈 Transformer，每個 token 會運行其 24 層中的 12 層三次。這讓模型能夠在內部進行更長時間的推理，而無需生成額外的文字。在 Artificial Analysis 的智慧指數（Intelligence Index）上，它與 Qwen3.8 27B 並列，且成本大約低了六倍。

New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop

Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token. This lets the model reason internally for longer without generating extra text. On Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index, it ties with Qwen3.8 27B at roughly six times lower cost. The article New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop appeared first on The Decoder .

AWS 表示，無論是使用者本人，還是 AI 代理，現在都能更輕鬆地在 AWS Marketplace 購買軟體與資料，目的是減少整個購買流程中的阻力。
Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft

Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, math's most famous open problem for 167 years, with a proof formalized in Lean that spans over 250,000 pages. Just hours later, Stanford researchers published an independent, entirely human competing proof, and mathematicians are now checking whether either one holds up. The article Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft appeared first on The Decoder .
